title: Banner Band members and locating Gus Fontenette
summary: She names Banner Band members including Weegee Payne, William Williams and the Adam brothers, and they discuss where Gus lives for a future interview.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
